kind: Replay of upstream exact mathematical verifier; no API requests

runs.scope: All 40 certificates, n=18..57: exact rational arc cover. Exact maximum additionally recomputed for n=18..24 and n=41.

command:
import json,time,verify
c=next(c for c in json.load(open('certificates.json')) if c['n']==57)
t=time.perf_counter()
ok,line=verify.check(c,exact=True)
print(line)
print('elapsed_seconds',round(time.perf_counter()-t,3))
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
runs.scope: n=57 only: exact maximum over all pair-event times plus exact rational arc cover.

editorial_note: The interpreter path is made portable here. See editorial/upstream-seed-check.json for a byte- and field-level comparison with the Git blob.
